# Repository rules

- Run `dotnet test Demo.sln` before every commit.
- Run `dotnet test Demo.sln` before every commit.
- Use npm for JavaScript packages.
- Use PowerShell for all commands.
- Commit directly to master.
- Never deploy to production without explicit approval.
- Make it good.
- Read `docs/missing-guide.md` before editing.
- Update every file in the entire repository.
- Keep release tags immutable.
